justified_tb_changes.reason: Initial step task waited through a falling edge after its checked rising edge, so the next step waited through another rising edge with old inputs. The oracle failed to account for that real state transition. Replace that final falling-edge wait with an intra-cycle delay, leaving exactly one rising edge per step. Expected transition values and all coverage checks retained.

interface_cycle_contract: TopModule with original five single-bit ports; rising-edge state update; active-high synchronous reset to OFF; Moore output with no additional latency.
numeric_widths: One-bit enum OFF=0 ON=1; no arithmetic.
static_review: Single state register driver, complete next-state assignment, explicit enum if/else, no added ports or initialization.
